signature.one_line: Doorstep two-camera interview: small subtitles, top promise pill, broadcast lower third, keyword pill.
unique_devices: Doorstep cold open: handheld chase toward a stranger's door with a whip blur, 5 cuts in the first ~2 % of runtime, first word inside one frame
Static promise pill at the top for the first ~10 %: white humanist sans on a black rounded box, one bold accent key word on line 2

Broadcast lower third that builds in ~0.75 s: second accent role tag wipes in and types on letter by letter, then a white box with a black serif name and an offset second accent bar, plus a white company-logo tile under the subtitle
Small 1-2 line humanist-sans subtitles on a faint translucent box at ~76 % H, so the pills and faces own attention; CTA pill laid over the emotional payoff, not after it
signature.why_it_works: Starts mid-action with a big promise on screen, then cuts host/guest on nearly every sentence so a long, conversational interview keeps momentum.

hook.first_frame: Handheld, rainy wet street seen while running toward a gate; black rounded title pill fixed at the top with one accent key word

structure.what: chase to the door, whip blur, a doorstep question to the owner; promise pill on screen
asks for a few minutes; guest invites the host in
credential: broadcast lower third + company logo tile; family business background
context and philosophy: heritage room, a classic quote, family memories
career advice; mid-roll sponsor integration with logo pill + link-in-bio pill
why businesses fail; one emotional photo insert; closing life lesson
comment-keyword pill over the closing lines and thank-you

pacing.pace: frenetic, front-loaded (~80 cuts/min in the first ~8 %, then 20-45)

captions.what: small broadcast subtitles on a faint translucent box
captions.how: 1-10 words (~6), up to 2 centred lines, centre y 76.2 % H, max line width 57 % W; humanist sans 38 px white on rgba(0,0,0,.25); full punctuation; hard cut ~1 frame before the first word

background_text.how: solid black rounded box x 16-83 %, y 8-20.5 %, 2 centred lines at 12.1 % / 16.4 % H; line 1 white regular ~65 px, line 2 key word bold accent ~74 px; static on every frame

second accent tag x 16-60 %, y 59.4-62.3 % with small white serif role line; white box x 15.5-77 %, y 62.7-67 % with black serif name (~58 px) and a second accent offset bar; tag wipes in L->R ~5 frames, text types on ~8 frames, name box wipes ~3 frames, name fades ~3 frames; white rounded logo tile x 35.8-64 %, y 79.4-90.2 %
'Link in Bio' white bold on dark grey rounded pill, centre y 13.6 %, ~5.8 % H; sponsor logo on a white rounded pill x 25.6-74.2 %, centre y 67.5 %, ~7.3 % H

broll_inserts.how: ~1 s still of family photos before the closing lesson

camera.what: two handheld cameras, host and guest singles
camera.how: MCU singles alternating per sentence, occasional walking two-shots; no punch-ins

transitions.what: hard cuts between the two cameras
transitions.how: ~half on pauses, ~half mid-sentence; handheld motion blur reads as soft

transitions.what: one whip / motion blur in the cold open

end_card.how: solid black rounded pill x 20-78 %, centre y 67.4 %, ~6.2 % H: 'Comment' white medium + keyword in curly quotes bold pale accent; over the closing lines

style.look_intent: natural, slightly warm, mid-to-high contrast; wet greens and gold exteriors, tungsten heritage interiors

sfx: hits/whooshes on about half the hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.48)

use_when: Run-and-gun interview footage from one or two handheld cameras on location
The guest has a strong credential worth a broadcast lower third and a promise title
A longer conversational piece (1-3 min) that needs fast cutting to hold attention
There is a sponsor or lead magnet to integrate as pills
avoid_when: Solo talking-head content (the format relies on host/guest alternation)
Sub-30 s clips where the lower third and promise pill have no room
Brands wanting bold kinetic captions (subtitles here are deliberately small)
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B15 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B15.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 25 fps. Two handheld cameras (host + guest), location sound.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} key word >= 7:1 on the black pill; white subtitle >= 4.5:1 on its faint box over the footage; {{ACCENT_2}} tag >= 4.5:1 behind white text)
- {{TEXT}}: default #FFFFFF (subtitles, pill text)
- {{ACCENT}}: default #EEFB1F (title key word; CTA keyword #E8F582)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: default #2771B3 (lower-third role tag and offset bar)
- {{SURFACE}}: default #000000 (title and CTA pills); subtitle box rgba(0,0,0,.25)
- {{CARD_BG}}: default #FCFCFD (name box, logo tile)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Playfair Display 400 (serif name and role)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Noto Sans 400/700 (subtitles, title pill)
- {{HANDLE}}: default @handle
- {{LOGO}}: company logo tile + sponsor logo pill

CAPTIONS (subtitles)
1. Latin, as spoken, sentence case with full punctuation (commas, full stops, ?, !, ellipsis when continuing); correct proper nouns; no emoji.
2. A sentence or clause per subtitle (1-10 words, ~6), up to 2 centred lines, max line width 57 % W (margins >= 20 % W).
3. {{FONT_BODY}} 400 at 38 px, {{TEXT}}, no stroke/shadow, on a translucent rgba(0,0,0,.25) box, padding ~1.5 % W, small radius.
4. Centre y 76.2 % H (2-line block ~75.5 %).
5. Hard cut in ~1 frame before the first word; hard cut out on the next subtitle.

OTHER TEXT AND EDIT DEVICES
6. Promise title pill (first ~10 % of runtime, static): {{SURFACE}} rounded box x 16-83 %, y 8-20.5 %, radius ~3 % W; line 1 'Headline here' {{FONT_BODY}} 400 65 px {{TEXT}} at 12.1 % H; line 2 with the KEY WORD in {{FONT_BODY}} 700 74 px {{ACCENT}} at 16.4 % H.
7. Lower third once at the name reveal (~11-14 % of runtime, ~75 frames): {{ACCENT_2}} tag x 16-60 %, y 59.4-62.3 % with small white serif 'Role, Company'; {{CARD_BG}} box x 15.5-77 %, y 62.7-67 % with black {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 'Name Surname' (~58 px) and an offset {{ACCENT_2}} bar; tag wipes L->R ~5 frames, role types on ~8 frames, name box wipes ~3 frames, name fades ~3 frames. {{LOGO}} on a white rounded tile x 35.8-64 %, y 79.4-90.2 %.
8. Sponsor (~60 % of runtime, ~150 frames): 'Link in Bio' white bold on a dark grey rounded pill at 13.6 % H (~5.8 % H tall); sponsor logo on a white rounded pill x 25.6-74.2 % at 67.5 % H (~7.3 % H tall).
9. CTA over the last ~8 % (during the payoff, not after): {{SURFACE}} rounded pill x 20-78 % at 67.4 % H (~6.2 % H tall): 'Comment' Inter 500 ~57 px white + '“KEYWORD”' Inter 700 ~59 px {{ACCENT}}.
10. Cold open: handheld approach with one whip (~6 frames), ~5 cuts in the first ~2 %; then cut host/guest on nearly every sentence (median ~1 s), easing to 20-45 cuts/min. One ~1 s emotional photo insert before the closing lesson. No punch-ins.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: natural, slightly warm, mid-high contrast, rich exterior greens, tungsten interiors.
SOUND: location dialogue up front, low bed (~5 dB under speech gaps), hits on ~half the cuts; -14 LUFS, true peak <= -2 dBTP.
